fusions.name: Grasping Pitch
fusions.desc: A flung clod that deals 4 damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Eightfold Rockfall
fusions.desc: Hurls 6 stones at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage and knocking its target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Stone Limbs
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to raise a stone totem beside you for 14 seconds. It strikes enemies within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Many Hands Brace
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition, you gain a ward that absorbs 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
